guards.step_title: My experiences, ride recording and ride results
guards.surface: S-213 Recording controls card / Ride recording
guards.situation: Double tap lock: in the old card the start/stop/pause buttons are locked while an action runs (busy, half-transparent).
guards.customer_sees: Buttons fade to 50 % and ignore taps while working.
v2_where: lib/features/routes/v2/record_dock_v2.dart:67,70,80-81,94,146 and home/v2/home_record_row_v2.dart:116,174 have NO busy lock; only lib/features/routes/v2/rides/recorder_screen_v2.dart:49-58 has one. Provider re-entry guards: ride_recorder.dart:295 (_starting), :402 (single-flight stop), ride_recorder_pause.dart:237 (pause idempotent)

lib/features/routes/v2/rides/recorder_screen_v2.dart:49-57 (_run returns while _busy; CTA busy/disabled at :74-77); old controls lib/features/routes/ride_rec_controls.dart:245-254 use the same _busy pattern
guards.verdict_evidence: The dock CTA / record disc / pause disc can be tapped again while the first action is still running. The notifier stops a second ride from being created, but the customer gets no 'busy' state and a racing second start can surface a spurious result message. The old card blocked this visibly.

guards.step_title: My experiences, ride recording and ride results
guards.situation: A rental (automatic) recording cannot be stopped by the customer: the Stop button exists only for an own manual ride.

guards.server: no (finish_user_ride accepts any own ride; rental rides are closed by close_stale_user_rides when the rental ends)
guards.verdict_evidence: Every v2 stop button is behind rec.canStop or rec.needsDecision (manual only).
